_comment: CN-P4 S4.3 — the conceptual tier in the declared layer (cn contracts §5, A-CN-10). The estate is shared/testdata/cn-estate, compiled by the REAL producer at the pinned grammar (LexiconBuild.run -> archive v6) and read back through LexiconArchiveSource, so a red case means the chain broke. Each query runs twice: through Lookup (the resolver's path) and through Match (the fuzzy.match:v1 door's), and both must return the same exact-form targets; narrowing Match to one reading's category returns that reading alone. Classes: concept (a concept's term reaches its cn ref, served as an er object's term is), beside (a form a concept and an element both carry returns both readings, at one score; the resolver orders them, S4.4), member (a member term stays the member: the matcher never lifts, the resolver does). Provenance: authored 2026-10-23 against the cn-estate fixture (an invented shop package).
